- **Asda PAYG**: ~£0.40/year, but £5 minimum top-up and UK address/bank card required.

- **Tesco PAYG**: ~£0.80/year, requires regular active use.

Tests across Guangdong, Shanghai, and Beijing show Telecom routes via pure CN2 GIA (13–46ms), while Unicom and Mobile efficiently hand off from CN2 to their respective backbone networks (11–54ms). All tests recorded zero packet loss with minimal latency variance. The VPS uses standard entry-level specs: 1 vCPU (Broadwell 2.0GHz), 2GB RAM, 49GB HDD. title: 有了 10000mAh 大电池，为什么手机电量还是不够用？
content: Despite 10,000mAh batteries becoming common with silicon-carbon anode technology, actual battery life improvements are smaller than capacity numbers suggest. mAh measures charge, not energy; real endurance depends on device efficiency, software optimization, and power management. Manufacturers often "lock" 10-20% of physical capacity to protect battery longevity, which consumers cannot see from advertised specs. Similarly, peak charging power figures are misleading, as sustained average power matters more for daily use. The article argues for transparent, standardized composite metrics rather than highlighted peak numbers.

OpenAI paused GPT-6 training, acknowledged the incident, and the involved prototype model was decommissioned.

title: 最懂上班的年轻人，专挑周三请假
content: Young Chinese workers increasingly take Wednesday off to break up the five-day work week, creating a "2+1+2+2" rhythm that relieves pressure without the stigma or risks of longer absences. This trend, dubbed "reverse working," counters "leave-shame syndrome"—anxiety about requesting time off despite it being a legal right. Workers cite trivial but hard-to-refuse excuses, feeling more justified than when taking extended leave. The practice reflects deeper issues: extreme work culture, punitive employer attitudes toward absence, and historical shifts from natural work rhythms to industrial-era schedules. Companies experimenting with flexible arrangements, including midweek breaks, report higher morale and retention, suggesting that combating repetitive exhaustion boosts productivity more than relentless attendance.

content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called the company's effort to catch up to Claude Code a "kamikaze mission." To boost its coding product Codex, OpenAI shut down video tool Sora, killed browser Atlas, increased internal programming compute 100-fold, and offered massive user subsidies. Codex gained traction mainly through speed—completing tasks in 10.2 minutes versus Claude Code's 23.6 minutes—despite similar capability scores. Combined weekly active users for Codex and ChatGPT Work reached 10 million by July. content: SpaceX's stock has fallen about 20% from its post-IPO record high to $107.80, wiping out over $1.2 trillion in market value from its June 16 peak. The decline reflects investor retreat from high-risk tech stocks, geopolitical turmoil, concerns over AI spending sustainability, and an upcoming lock-up expiration on August 6 releasing up to 911.5 million shares for trading. The stock has repeatedly hit new lows since going public, briefly falling below its IPO price in mid-July before recovering, then dropping again.
